products.name: PULS CP10.241
products.description: CP10.241；官方额定参数。额定类别：Nom.。Output rating is at nominal24V. At adjusted28V, allowable currents differ; do not retain24V current as though universal. Blanket source footer says values typical unless otherwise noted. Nom., Min., Max., explicit allowed limits andTyp remain distinguishable in evidence. Transient264–300VAC range max500ms is not part of continuous85–264VAC input coverage. Rated profile intentionally excludes continuous≤45°C PowerBoost; it therefore describes rated capacity, not maximum possible sustained capacity. Source inconsistency: installationp4 says designed altitudeup5000m; environmentp17 gives2000–6000m withderating. Store conservative cap5000m; rated profile restricts≤2000m.
